findings.evidence: Lines 176–179 include `hFi`; lines 135–142 nevertheless call the theorem the “only if” half. The underlying equality used at line 147 is `image_frontier_eq_frontier_image`, whose declaration at `BoundaryCorrespondence.lean:260–263` also explicitly requires injectivity.
findings.fix: Prove the boundary conclusion without `hFi`—for example, add the required planar/simply-connected result deriving boundary local connectedness from the locally connected image closure—or describe this only as the stronger injective-extension special case and stop claiming it proves Carathéodory’s necessary half.
findings.issue: `locallyConnectedSpace_frontier_image_ball` requires `InjOn F (closedBall 0 1)`, while Carathéodory’s necessary direction concludes local connectedness from existence of an arbitrary continuous extension of the Riemann map; boundary injectivity is neither assumed nor generally available for locally connected non-Jordan boundaries.

summary: The boundary result is substantially weaker than the claimed necessary half of Carathéodory’s continuity theorem because it assumes the extension is injective.
